--- { balance: remainingBalance, amount: withdrawAmount, accountNumber: vars.accountNumber }]
set-variable.doc:name: leftBalance mapping

snowflake:update.doc:name: Update account data after money withdraw
snowflake:update.snowflake:sql:
UPDATE MYDATABASE.PUBLIC.BANK_CUSTOMER_DATA SET BALANCE = :balance,
TRANSACTIONS = ARRAY_APPEND( COALESCE(TRANSACTIONS, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT()), OBJECT_CONSTRUCT( 'accountNumber', ACCOUNTNUMBER, 'transactionType', 'WITHDRAW', 'amount', :amount, 'balanceAfterTransaction', :balance, 'timestamp', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() ) ),
LAST_TRANSACTION_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
WHERE ACCOUNTNUMBER = :accountNumber;
snowflake:update.snowflake:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { balance: vars.leftBalance.balance as String, amount: vars.amount, accountNumber: vars.accountNumber, }]
